verdict.rationale: Qodo documents an official Agentic Toolbox CLI that you install locally to use Qodo-managed skills with your coding agent. Those skills include reviewing changes before opening a PR and retrieving the applicable rules and standards. A community user also reports hands-on use of the Qodo Command CLI and its rwx permission toggle. Missing for 10: a detailed command reference and installation steps in the evidence, and independent corroboration specific to the current Agentic Toolbox CLI rather than the earlier Qodo Command CLI.
